items.headline: U.S. Economy Unexpectedly Loses 23,000 Jobs in July as Markets Rally
items.summary: On August 7, 2026, official data showed that the U.S. labor market unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July, while the overall unemployment rate held at 4.1 percent. Despite the sudden contraction, major stock indices surged as investors anticipated that the Federal Reserve would pause further interest rate increases.

items.headline: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Crosses $1 Billion at Global Box Office
items.summary: Director Christopher Nolan's epic film 'The Odyssey' officially surpassed $1 billion at the global box office on Friday. The achievement marks Nolan's third movie to hit ten figures worldwide and makes it the fifth film to reach the milestone this year.
